contract: The machine-readable Observatory step ledger: one entry per PR that carried a roadmap step, with the feature ids it shipped, its head branch, and its status. tests/f111-ci-inventory.test.js enforces that no feature id is recorded as shipped twice (the step-6 #173/#174 double-ship damage class), that every retirement cites a real repair, that every entry's declared featureIds agree with its own title, and that this ledger and the human roadmap checkboxes in docs/OBSERVATORY-STATE.md do not disagree about what shipped. Drift that is RECORDED rather than fixed lives in knownRoadmapDrift, and the gate fails both on a new drift and on an allowlisted drift that stops being observed - so the list cannot become a rubbish drawer.
closesHandoff: docs/OBSERVATORY-STATE.md §Handoff-findings #12 ('the roadmap can schedule the SAME step twice, and nothing detects it')

statusVocabulary.merged-canonical: shipped, and it is the ONE implementation that survived a de-duplication
statusVocabulary.merged-then-retired: was merged, then superseded by a repair; must cite retiredBy
statusVocabulary.open: in flight - a second PR with the same feature id is a sibling, not a new step

entries.title: F110: Live Patch Protocol (patch channel + audit log + rollback) [FINAL STEP]
entries.note: FINAL STEP of the 10-step roadmap. Shipped as spec variant F110a (patch channel + audit + rollback, NO live component swap): the roadmap line's 'module federation' was never feasible here - F59 ships the UI as ONE inlined file (vite-plugin-singlefile), so there is no chunk graph for a federation runtime to resolve against, and remote-code execution on an authenticated socket would remove the last boundary worth auditing. F110b (per-frame asymmetric signatures + the dynamic-import swap the roadmap line's 'module federation' actually implies) is filed as follow-up issue #179 with that reason and the measured WebCrypto numbers. The code commit carries number:null (no PR exists yet); the post-PR commit recorded #180 and ticked the Step 9 roadmap box in the same commit (PR opened 2026-10-08 02:11Z), per the pattern #177 and #178 established. Rides the EXISTING /ws socket (no route, no credential) and the EXISTING toggle map (no second source of truth), and declares both of its persistence surfaces to F111's inventory.

knownRoadmapDrift.match: roadmap Step 6 names branch arena/fa27adb3-supreme-lamp (ledger: #174) but cites #173 instead
knownRoadmapDrift.why: REAL ERROR IN THE AUTHORITATIVE DOCUMENT, recorded not rewritten. The Step-6 roadmap line reads 'landed on `arena/fa27adb3-supreme-lamp`, PR **#173**', but arena/fa27adb3 is #174 (verified against the GitHub API: #173 = arena/66a13a8c, #174 = arena/fa27adb3). The line describing the double-ship mis-attributes which PR was which - the exact confusion that caused it. Not fixed in place because §UI-ACCUMULATOR-FILES forbids rewriting another step's record, and because a gate that PINS a known, explained inconsistency is worth more than a silent edit. Operator fix, if wanted: change that line's '#173' to '#174' and delete this allowlist entry in the same commit (the gate fails on an allowlisted drift that stops being observed).

knownRoadmapDrift.match: ledger #174 (step 6) is not cited by any Step 6 roadmap line

Recorded for the same reason as above.
